enemy-050-korari-stalker.method: Visually traced thoracic mass immediately behind the shoulder on all active source poses. Existing source-local body points were independently checked against the actual torso, not rederived from tail/head bounding-box extents. Grounded roots use the observed hoof/paw or resting-body support plane exactly. Three transparent extraction-padding pixels are explicitly excluded from the physical root; the normalizer must trim alpha-zero padding rather than shift the measured support. Airborne Korari pounce roots recover the raw authored clearance relative to grounded neighbours before recomposition erased it; one prior uniform clip factor converts that distance only, never rescaling the active body.
